models.target: 至少两段下跌，第一段到均线

stats.note: 连续买入高潮后的反转尤其可靠

formula.pine:
//@version=5
// 模型：买入高潮反做空
indicator("买入高潮反做空", overlay=true)
bcl20 = math.sum((close > open and (close - low) / (high - low) > 0.70) ? 1 : 0, 3) >= 3 and volume > ta.sma(volume, 20)
crs70 = close < open and (high - close) / (high - low) > 70 / 100 and close < close[1]
abody20 = ta.sma(math.abs(close - open), 20)
ssig20_12 = close < open and (high - close) > (high - low) * 0.60 and math.abs(close - open) > abody20 * 12 / 10
outb = high > high[1] and low < low[1]
vsur20_15 = volume > ta.sma(volume, 20) * 15 / 10
srev30 = high > low and (high - math.max(close, open)) / (high - low) > 30 / 100 and (high - close) / (high - low) > 60 / 100
sbs5 = math.sum(close > close[1] ? 1 : 0, 5) >= 4 and close > ta.highest(close[1], 5)
sig = bcl20 and crs70 and ((ssig20_12 ? 1 : 0) + (outb ? 1 : 0) + (vsur20_15 ? 1 : 0) + (srev30 ? 1 : 0)) >= 1 and not (sbs5)
plotshape(sig, title="信号", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.red, 0))

models.name: 主要趋势反转做多（MTR）
models.entry: 下降趋势被突破后出现回踩不破时买入
models.target: 测量移动目标，或整个下跌段的等距反弹

stats.note: 大反转胜率不高但空间大，靠盈亏比取胜

formula.pine:
//@version=5
// 模型：主要趋势反转做多（MTR）
indicator("主要趋势反转做多（MTR）", overlay=true)
dnt20 = ta.highest(high, 20) < ta.highest(high, 20)[20] and ta.lowest(low, 20) <= ta.lowest(low, 20)[20]
bph20 = high > ta.highest(high, 20)[1] and close > ta.highest(high, 20)[1]
cnh70 = high > low and (close - low) / (high - low) >= 70 / 100
db_l120 = ta.lowest(low, 20)
db_l220 = ta.lowest(low, 20)[20]
dbot20 = math.abs(db_l120 - db_l220) / db_l120 < 2 / 100 and low <= db_l120 * 1.03
wedb20 = ta.lowest(low, 20) < ta.lowest(low, 20)[20] and ta.highest(high, 20) < ta.highest(high, 20)[20] and (ta.highest(high, 20) - ta.lowest(low, 20)) < (ta.highest(high, 20)[20] - ta.lowest(low, 20)[20])
abody20 = ta.sma(math.abs(close - open), 20)
scl20 = math.sum((close < open and (high - close) / (high - low) > 0.70) ? 1 : 0, 3) >= 3 and volume > ta.sma(volume, 20)
cbb3 = ta.barssince(not (close > open)) > 3
vsur20_15 = volume > ta.sma(volume, 20) * 15 / 10
sbr5 = math.sum(close < close[1] ? 1 : 0, 5) >= 4 and close < ta.lowest(close[1], 5)
sig = dnt20 and bph20 and cnh70 and ((dbot20 ? 1 : 0) + (wedb20 ? 1 : 0) + (scl20 ? 1 : 0) + (cbb3 ? 1 : 0) + (vsur20_15 ? 1 : 0)) >= 2 and not (sbr5)
plotshape(sig, title="信号", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.red, 0))

models.name: 主要趋势反转做空（MTR）
models.entry: 上涨趋势被跌破后反弹受阻时做空
models.target: 测量移动目标

stats.note: 顶部反转常伴随高潮，等确认再进

formula.pine:
//@version=5
// 模型：主要趋势反转做空（MTR）
indicator("主要趋势反转做空（MTR）", overlay=true)
upt20 = ta.lowest(low, 20) > ta.lowest(low, 20)[20] and ta.highest(high, 20) >= ta.highest(high, 20)[20]
bpl20 = low < ta.lowest(low, 20)[1] and close < ta.lowest(low, 20)[1]
cnl70 = high > low and (high - close) / (high - low) >= 70 / 100
dt_h120 = ta.highest(high, 20)
dt_h220 = ta.highest(high, 20)[20]
dtop20 = math.abs(dt_h120 - dt_h220) / dt_h120 < 2 / 100 and high >= dt_h120 * 0.97
wedt20 = ta.highest(high, 20) > ta.highest(high, 20)[20] and ta.lowest(low, 20) > ta.lowest(low, 20)[20] and (ta.highest(high, 20) - ta.lowest(low, 20)) < (ta.highest(high, 20)[20] - ta.lowest(low, 20)[20])
bcl20 = math.sum((close > open and (close - low) / (high - low) > 0.70) ? 1 : 0, 3) >= 3 and volume > ta.sma(volume, 20)
cbr3 = ta.barssince(not (close < open)) > 3
vsur20_15 = volume > ta.sma(volume, 20) * 15 / 10
sbs5 = math.sum(close > close[1] ? 1 : 0, 5) >= 4 and close > ta.highest(close[1], 5)
sig = upt20 and bpl20 and cnl70 and ((dtop20 ? 1 : 0) + (wedt20 ? 1 : 0) + (bcl20 ? 1 : 0) + (cbr3 ? 1 : 0) + (vsur20_15 ? 1 : 0)) >= 2 and not (sbs5)
plotshape(sig, title="信号", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.red, 0))

models.target: 回到区间，通常至少两段下跌

//@version=5
// 模型：多头陷阱反做空
indicator("多头陷阱反做空", overlay=true)

cnl70 = high > low and (high - close) / (high - low) >= 70 / 100
vsur20_15 = volume > ta.sma(volume, 20) * 15 / 10

emdn20 = emav20 < emav20[5]
sbs5 = math.sum(close > close[1] ? 1 : 0, 5) >= 4 and close > ta.highest(close[1], 5)

models.entry: 假跌破K线上方 1 tick 买入
models.target: 回到区间上方，通常至少两段上涨

stats.note: 空头被套后回补会加速反弹

formula.pine:
//@version=5
// 模型：空头陷阱反做多
indicator("空头陷阱反做多", overlay=true)
pl20 = ta.lowest(low, 20)[1]
fbd20 = low < pl20 and close > pl20
abody20 = ta.sma(math.abs(close - open), 20)
bsig20_12 = close > open and (close - low) > (high - low) * 0.60 and math.abs(close - open) > abody20 * 12 / 10
cnh70 = high > low and (close - low) / (high - low) >= 70 / 100
vsur20_15 = volume > ta.sma(volume, 20) * 15 / 10
outb = high > high[1] and low < low[1]
brev30 = high > low and (math.min(close, open) - low) / (high - low) > 30 / 100 and (close - low) / (high - low) > 60 / 100
emav20 = ta.ema(close, 20)
emup20 = emav20 > emav20[5]
sbr5 = math.sum(close < close[1] ? 1 : 0, 5) >= 4 and close < ta.lowest(close[1], 5)
sig = fbd20 and bsig20_12 and cnh70 and ((vsur20_15 ? 1 : 0) + (outb ? 1 : 0) + (brev30 ? 1 : 0) + (emup20 ? 1 : 0)) >= 1 and not (sbr5)

models.name: 区间底部高抛低吸做多（BLSHS）
models.entry: 价格进入底部 1/3 且出现看涨信号K线时买入
models.target: 快进快出，区间中部即止盈，不贪区间顶部

stats.note: 区间里必须快速止盈，目标是赚点差不是赚波段

formula.pine:
//@version=5
// 模型：区间底部高抛低吸做多（BLSHS）
indicator("区间底部高抛低吸做多（BLSHS）", overlay=true)
rh20 = ta.highest(high, 20)
rl20 = ta.lowest(low, 20)
itr20 = rh20 < ta.highest(high, 20)[20] and rl20 > ta.lowest(low, 20)[20]
rbt20 = close <= rl20 + (rh20 - rl20) / 3
abody20 = ta.sma(math.abs(close - open), 20)
bsig20_12 = close > open and (close - low) > (high - low) * 0.60 and math.abs(close - open) > abody20 * 12 / 10
brev30 = high > low and (math.min(close, open) - low) / (high - low) > 30 / 100 and (close - low) / (high - low) > 60 / 100
cnh70 = high > low and (close - low) / (high - low) >= 70 / 100
vdry20_8 = volume < ta.sma(volume, 20) * 8 / 10
pl20 = ta.lowest(low, 20)[1]
fbd20 = low < pl20 and close > pl20
atr20 = ta.atr(20)
ttr20 = atr20 < ta.sma(close, 20) * 1 / 100
upt10 = ta.lowest(low, 10) > ta.lowest(low, 10)[10] and ta.highest(high, 10) >= ta.highest(high, 10)[10]
sig = itr20 and rbt20 and bsig20_12 and ((brev30 ? 1 : 0) + (cnh70 ? 1 : 0) + (vdry20_8 ? 1 : 0) + (fbd20 ? 1 : 0)) >= 1 and not (ttr20 or upt10)
plotshape(sig, title="信号", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.red, 0))

models.target: 区间中部即止盈

stats.note: 区间交易要快，不要期待趋势

models.name: 区间向上突破跟随
models.entry: 突破区间上沿且收盘站稳后买入
models.target: 区间高度的等距测量移动

stats.note: 区间突破的成功率高于普通突破，但仍需收盘确认

formula.pine:
//@version=5
// 模型：区间向上突破跟随
indicator("区间向上突破跟随", overlay=true)
rh20 = ta.highest(high, 20)
rl20 = ta.lowest(low, 20)
itr20 = rh20 < ta.highest(high, 20)[20] and rl20 > ta.lowest(low, 20)[20]
bph20 = high > ta.highest(high, 20)[1] and close > ta.highest(high, 20)[1]
bsc70 = close > open and (high - low) > 0 and (close - low) / (high - low) > 70 / 100
vsur20_15 = volume > ta.sma(volume, 20) * 15 / 10
abody20 = ta.sma(math.abs(close - open), 20)
bbb20_15 = close > open and math.abs(close - open) > abody20 * 15 / 10
gup = low > high[1]
mmu20 = close > ta.lowest(low, 20) + (ta.highest(high, 20) - ta.lowest(low, 20)) and ta.highest(high, 20) > ta.lowest(low, 20)
ph20 = ta.highest(high, 20)[1]
fbu20 = high > ph20 and close < ph20
sig = itr20 and bph20 and bsc70 and ((vsur20_15 ? 1 : 0) + (bbb20_15 ? 1 : 0) + (gup ? 1 : 0) + (mmu20 ? 1 : 0)) >= 2 and not (fbu20)
plotshape(sig, title="信号", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.red, 0))

models.name: 缺口 + 测量移动做多
models.entry: 缺口后第一根强势K线上方买入
models.stop: 缺口下沿下方（缺口回补即失效）
models.target: 测量缺口意味着后面还有等距的测量移动

stats.note: 趋势运行 10-20 根K线后的缺口，最可能成为测量缺口

formula.pine:
//@version=5
// 模型：缺口 + 测量移动做多
indicator("缺口 + 测量移动做多", overlay=true)
gup = low > high[1]
cnh70 = high > low and (close - low) / (high - low) >= 70 / 100
upt10 = ta.lowest(low, 10) > ta.lowest(low, 10)[10] and ta.highest(high, 10) >= ta.highest(high, 10)[10]
guf10 = ta.lowest(low, 10) > high[10]
vsur20_15 = volume > ta.sma(volume, 20) * 15 / 10
mmu20 = close > ta.lowest(low, 20) + (ta.highest(high, 20) - ta.lowest(low, 20)) and ta.highest(high, 20) > ta.lowest(low, 20)
ema20 = ta.ema(close, 20)
ema60 = ta.ema(close, 60)
estk20_60 = ema20 > ema60
ph20 = ta.highest(high, 20)[1]
fbu20 = high > ph20 and close < ph20
sig = gup and cnh70 and upt10 and ((guf10 ? 1 : 0) + (vsur20_15 ? 1 : 0) + (mmu20 ? 1 : 0) + (estk20_60 ? 1 : 0)) >= 1 and not (fbu20)
plotshape(sig, title="信号", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.red, 0))

models.name: 早盘高开跟随做多
models.entry: 早盘第一根K线收在高位后跟进
models.target: 当日测量移动，或前一日高点

stats.note: 早盘不被回补的缺口常常决定当天方向

formula.pine:
//@version=5
// 模型：早盘高开跟随做多
indicator("早盘高开跟随做多", overlay=true)
ogu = open > high[1]
osb65 = high > low and (close - low) / (high - low) > 65 / 100 and math.abs(close - open) / (high - low) > 40 / 100
cnh70 = high > low and (close - low) / (high - low) >= 70 / 100
vsur20_15 = volume > ta.sma(volume, 20) * 15 / 10
abody20 = ta.sma(math.abs(close - open), 20)
bbb20_15 = close > open and math.abs(close - open) > abody20 * 15 / 10
upt10 = ta.lowest(low, 10) > ta.lowest(low, 10)[10] and ta.highest(high, 10) >= ta.highest(high, 10)[10]
oir = open <= high[1] and open >= low[1]
ph20 = ta.highest(high, 20)[1]
fbu20 = high > ph20 and close < ph20
sig = ogu and osb65 and cnh70 and ((vsur20_15 ? 1 : 0) + (bbb20_15 ? 1 : 0) + (upt10 ? 1 : 0)) >= 1 and not (oir or fbu20)
plotshape(sig, title="信号", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.red, 0))

models.name: 早盘低开跟随做空
models.entry: 早盘第一根K线收在低位后跟进做空
models.target: 当日测量移动

stats.note: 低开不回补则空头当天占优

formula.pine:
//@version=5
// 模型：早盘低开跟随做空
indicator("早盘低开跟随做空", overlay=true)
ogd = open < low[1]
cnl70 = high > low and (high - close) / (high - low) >= 70 / 100
abody20 = ta.sma(math.abs(close - open), 20)
ssig20_12 = close < open and (high - close) > (high - low) * 0.60 and math.abs(close - open) > abody20 * 12 / 10
vsur20_15 = volume > ta.sma(volume, 20) * 15 / 10
bbr20_15 = close < open and math.abs(close - open) > abody20 * 15 / 10
dnt10 = ta.highest(high, 10) < ta.highest(high, 10)[10] and ta.lowest(low, 10) <= ta.lowest(low, 10)[10]
oir = open <= high[1] and open >= low[1]
pl20 = ta.lowest(low, 20)[1]
fbd20 = low < pl20 and close > pl20
sig = ogd and cnl70 and ssig20_12 and ((vsur20_15 ? 1 : 0) + (bbr20_15 ? 1 : 0) + (dnt10 ? 1 : 0)) >= 1 and not (oir or fbd20)
plotshape(sig, title="信号", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.red, 0))

caveat: 公式由课程规则转写，属于「可回测的假设」而非「已验证的策略」。A 股做空工具受限，空头模型主要用于判断卖点与清仓时机。生成后请先在目标软件里跑历史选股，核对信号数量是否合理。
